pass_at_1_derivation.why_923_was_the_wrong_denominator: load_toke_solutions() dropped every generated solution that failed to compile (continue, no record kept), so those 77 solutions never became a TaskResult and left the denominator entirely. 588/923 is therefore Pass@1 GIVEN THAT THE SOLUTION COMPILED -- a different and strictly more generous quantity. A solution that fails to compile is a failed attempt, not an absent one, so the denominator is the 1,000 solutions generated. The inconsistency was visible inside this file: benchmark_size was already 1000 alongside pass_at_1 0.637.
pass_at_1_derivation.no_rerun_required: The correction is arithmetic over artefacts already on disk (toke-eval/benchmark/solutions/*.toke, n = 1000). No evaluation was re-run to produce it.
pass_at_1_derivation.corrected_by: story 128.19; defect recorded in toke-eval/docs/suspect-numbers-128-1c.md section 1

gate_result_note: Recorded as PASS on 2026-04-03 against the withdrawn 0.637 figure. The corrected Pass@1 of 0.588 is BELOW the declared pass_at_1_minimum of 0.60, so on its own criterion Gate 1 is not met. The compilation_rate criterion (0.923 >= 0.90) is still met. Re-deciding the Gate 1 verdict is an owner action and is deliberately not made here (story 128.19).
